rubric.tier: Technical fit and experience compatibility only: A strong demonstrated fit; B plausible fit with material uncertainty/stretch; C demonstrated core discipline/seniority mismatch; unknown insufficient JD evidence. Opportunity availability, staffing identity, pay and internship preference do not independently change technical tier.
rubric.eligibility: supported requires supplied evidence for applicable role constraints and candidate permission; blocked requires a demonstrated conflict; unknown when candidate authorization, sponsorship need, enrollment, location availability or material role rules are unestablished. Technical seniority gaps are tier findings, not legal permission findings.
rubric.confidence: Qualitative assessment certainty, not calibrated probability. A summary can support broad discipline mismatch while omitting job-specific eligibility.

limitations: AI silver assessment only; no human-verified ground truth and no causal production accuracy claim.
Historical regression summaries include prior evaluative wording; independent reader is blind to receipts/baselines but cannot be blind to those interpretations.
No live JD checks; saved source text can be incomplete, stale or incorrectly attributed.
Candidate work authorization and sponsorship need are absent; eligibility cannot be established from employer Sponsor/No sponsor metadata alone.
Two development cases refer to Figma job 6131089004; 20 case records represent at most 19 distinct opportunities. Group duplicates before aggregate evaluation.
A missing JD and a generic truncated JD produce unknown technical tiers.
This rubric was authored from development cases; held-out policy and rubric must be frozen separately before held-out case inspection.
